name: Runner Extras - Page Background Task Out Of Scope
brief: Issue #2514: CurrPage.EnqueueBackgroundTask and TestPage.RunPageBackgroundTask both run their child task synchronously through a real child NavSession/company bootstrap the runner's in-process skeleton cannot yet answer, so both must refuse loudly with RunnerOutOfScopeException naming the exact AL API instead of crashing on an unrelated internal NRE/ArgumentNullException.
description: This is deliberately NOT a claim about BC's own page-background-task behaviour (that belongs upstream once the runner can actually execute one) -- it asserts only the runner-specific contract: which API name and reason the refusal carries, and that the refusal happens before any AL-visible side effect the caller could mistake for partial success. See RunnerPageBackgroundTaskGap (AlRunner/Patches) and NclCecilRewrite.cs's rewrite of NavForm.EnqueueBackgroundTask / NavTestPage.ALRunPageBackgroundTask.
